title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL NVFP4 on vLLM, one DGX Spark (NVIDIA's recipe)
slug_note: NVIDIA's DGX Spark-only vLLM command: NVFP4 weights, LiLiCorr drafter, one sequence.

engine.config: NVIDIA card Quick Start for DGX Spark (GB10) only: 1 sequence, gpu-memory-utilization 0.75, DFlash with the LiLiCorr drafter (7 tokens)

requirements.notes: The card caps vLLM at 75% of GPU memory (about 96 GB of 128 GB) for weights, drafter and KV. Not measured.

run.command: vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4 --served-model-name nemotron-3.5-super-vl --max-num-seqs 1 --trust-remote-code --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --speculative_config.model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4-LiLiCorr --speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens 7 --speculative_config.method dflash --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5 --enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint --video-pruning-rate 0.5 --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"fps": 2, "num_frames": 256}}' --block-size 64 --prefix-match-unit 64 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3

steps.text: Start a container from vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 (or the card's pinned nightly) with GPU access; set HF_TOKEN if needed.

vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4 --served-model-name nemotron-3.5-super-vl --max-num-seqs 1 --trust-remote-code --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --speculative_config.model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4-LiLiCorr --speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens 7 --speculative_config.method dflash --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5 --enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint --video-pruning-rate 0.5 --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"fps": 2, "num_frames": 256}}' --block-size 64 --prefix-match-unit 64 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet. The owner's DGX Spark can measure this one directly.
NVIDIA says this configuration is for DGX Spark (GB10) only.
spec_decode is 'other': NVIDIA's DFlash method with the LiLiCorr drafter.
The card's command uses $MODEL / $DRAFT_MODEL shell variables; they are expanded to the repo ids here.

sources.note: NVIDIA card: Quick Start (DGX Spark only), deployment table, LiLiCorr drafter
